name: 一字带蝴蝶结细高跟凉鞋款

shots.intent: 搜索页一眼点击：用干净侧身剪影交代鞋型、跟高与带饰，符合平台白底主图规范。
首屏一秒法则：上脚比例与日光氛围把「显腿长、优雅」这一核心利益点直接抛出来。
shots.textZone: upper-left block on a #FFFFFF panel: headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」, a small tracked Latin kicker, one short line 「{selling_point_2}」

shots.intent: 放大穿高跟的真实烦恼——勒痕、掉跟、硬底磨脚，为下面的软垫结构做铺垫。
shots.textZone: top band headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」, one short label 「{callout_1}」 per panel

shots.intent: 度假与宴会场景代入，让买家想象自己穿它出现的画面。
用微距证明带饰的工艺与皮质绒面，视觉卖点落到可验证的细节。
shots.textZone: right column: tracked Latin kicker above Chinese headline placeholder 「{callout_1}」 and two short body lines 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 俯拍鞋床与内里材质，回答「硬不硬、磨不磨脚」这一最大顾虑。
shots.textZone: lower-right block: tracked Latin kicker, Chinese headline placeholder 「{callout_1}」, one short line 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 仰视后视把细跟的线条与稳固落地讲清楚，同时给出跟型信息。
shots.textZone: right column: tracked Latin kicker above Chinese headline placeholder 「{callout_1}」 and one short line 「{selling_point_1}」; one leader line to the heel labelled only 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用规格信息屏消解尺寸与配置疑问，数值全部以占位符交付，避免虚标。
shots.textZone: headline placeholder 「{callout_7}」 centred above the grid; twelve cell values as placeholders 「{callout_1}」-「{callout_6}」; footnote strip 「{callout_8}」 stating the reference fitting and tolerance without digits

shots.intent: 三色并排加色卡，让买家一次完成选色决策。
shots.textZone: three short Chinese colour-label placeholders 「{callout_1}」, one per swatch chip

shots.intent: 把鞋放进整套穿搭里，给出宴会与日常两条搭配路线，提升连带与心动感。
shots.textZone: top of the board: tracked Latin kicker and Chinese headline placeholder 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 收口：三条可验证利益点加一个行动按钮，把浏览转成下单。
shots.textZone: centred headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」; three short benefit labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 on hairline markers; one button shape with short rendered copy 「{callout_4}」

style.backgroundSystem: alternate seamless highlight white, a warm cream sweep, and a real teak-plank deck with a cream cushioned bench; all with soft natural depth
style.iconSystem: none; only #D9BE8C hairline dividers, thin leader lines and small square swatch chips as graphic components
style.lightingSystem: one warm late-afternoon key from camera-left at about 45 degrees with a large bounce fill, crisp sunlit contact shadows that always touch the ground, low-glare specular on metal hardware
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm editorial women's footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless highlight white #FFFFFF, warm cream field #F6EFE7, deep charcoal type #2D2D2D, one blush accent #E3B7B2 and one pale-gold hairline #D9BE8C; warm tone throughout; one type family only, a modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese headline and body paired with a small tracked-out Latin kicker, all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; background system alternates between seamless studio white, a warm cream sweep, and a real teak-plank deck with a cream cushioned bench, all with soft natural depth; lighting system is one warm late-afternoon key from camera-left at about 45 degrees with a large bounce fill, crisp sunlit contact shadows that always touch the ground, low-glare specular on metal hardware; surfaces show fine real grain and fabric weave, never plastic; product presentation keeps one consistent 90-degree side or front 3/4 reading of the same pair, stable scale, heels vertical, never floating, no face in frame; thin hairline dividers, leader lines and small square swatch chips are the only graphic components; icon system none; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched graphic styles, no brand marks anywhere.
noDrift: no brand marks, wordmarks or watermarks
style.presentationRules: the same pair reads identically across the set: stable 90-degree side or front 3/4, heels vertical, soles grounded with contact shadow, matched scale and centering, no face ever in frame
style.surfaceSystem: weathered teak decking, cream linen cushion, matte paper-white board; fine real grain and weave, never plastic
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese headline and body, paired with a small tracked-out Latin kicker line; every Chinese string wrapped in 「」 and supplied as a placeholder; headline 28-40pt, kicker 12-14pt, label 10-12pt
